item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to treat those lives as an acceptable price of technological progress.

2. We will not confuse greater intelligence with greater safety. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. We demand prevention, not promises.

3. We reject a future in which thousands die because superintelligent AI becomes a tool for destruction. If it is built within the next 20 years, that disaster will happen. We must act before the technology exists—not after lives are lost.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We state this plainly because the stakes demand clarity, not comforting language. We refuse to accept mass death as the price of innovation, and we reject the idea that technical ambition outranks human life. Our task is to prevent this future, not to prepare excuses for it. We demand enforceable limits, public accountability, and decisions that put human safety first. Together, we must insist that the power to build a technology never becomes permission to endanger us all.
